newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco's Chuquicamata boosts cathode output.
newsitem.headline: Codelco's Chuquicamata boosts cathode output.

text.p: Chile's state copper company Codelco's Chuquicamata division said it will increase annual cathode output at its low-grade sulphides plant by 3,650 tonnes to 18,250 tonnes.
The project will involve an investment of $4 million, said the division's Oasis magazine.
The magazine did not say when the expansion will be completed.
The project uses new heap-leaching technology to process the ore which has too little copper to treat profitably using the traditional concentrator and smelter.
